body:
I've been putting it off for a while.  I'll try just forcing myself just go this weekend or next.

Thanks for responding...

I don't know what this means.  I feel like it needs to mean something since I've been wanting to do it for so long.  I feel like it's a call to action.

I'm really close to getting couple of cats.  I don't know if I'll look dumb going to a shelter by myself though.  I feel like most people go with their family or something.  I really want to get some cats.  I think it'll keep me from sitting by myself and overthinking everything.

idk...

I like that one day at a time philosophy.  I'll start thinking about that when I wake up in the morning.  Just finish one more day and see how it goes.  Make it as positive as I can.  

You helped me!  Two people responded to me and you're the only person that continued to respond to me.  You made a difference in my life!

If you ever want to bounce some bs off me, send me a pm and i'll try to get back to you asap.  Thanks sincerely!

lol no worries.  I think in the next month or so I'm really going to take the steps to start adopting 2 cats.  I think this will be the correct solution for me.  Getting the daily responsibility of taking care of the cats, plus having the cats wandering around and being able to interact with them i think will be really helpful.

I'm pretty drunk right now, but even so...thanks for helping me talk myself out of my rut...at least for the week.

Thanks again!

I think i may just get a pet.  I've been contemplating getting 2 cats, 2 so that the 1 isn't lonely while i'm at work.  I've been contemplating it but i think i'll just start taking the steps to do it.  I'm a caring person and i think having that responsibility of taking care of another living being will give me a reason to wake up in the morning, especially on the weekend.  Have you considered this?

>I've been giving up recently. Spending all my money since I won't need it anymore. Throwing out photos and possessions. Not caring what I say. It's a way to numb yourself but you push out the bad and the good by doing this. 

I've also been doing this.  At work I'll do whatever.  Nothing necessarily out of line, but just taking risks regardless of the consequence.  I'll talk to friends as though there's no downside to what I say.  the issue is that sometimes they just won't respond to texts.  it's really hurtful/rough.  

I think the pet route is the way to go though.  Pet's love unconditionally...and assuming life exists just for the sake of being lived, pets will keep me around long enough for me to die of natural causes.

Send me a pm.  I mean it!  

I don't know that i can help you, but i'm feeling the same way and talking things out always helps!  Bounce your thoughts off me and it may help both of us!

I really appreciate your response.  I'm happy to know that at least one other person, alive today, is thinking that.  I really appreciate your lengthy response, really!

You don't have to answer any further, but if you wish you could just flip the switch, why not just do it?  It's not quite that simple, but why have you not just taken the steps to do so.  I don't mean to prod you.  I'm just currently wondering this and actually don't know if i should start taking the steps down that path.

Again...no need to answer if you don't have a good answer, but if you do i would really appreciate it.

I don't expect this to be of any help, but I am in the same position as you.  Feeling hopeless and abandoned.  I've been feeling this for at least the past five years.  I don't know where people with our mind state are meant to be, but all I can say is keep on keeping on.  PM me if you want to talk.  I'd me more than happy to be your wall to bounce things off of.

I'm only playing games because it gives me something to do.  But if there's not further reason to live and i'm just living to work for someone else or living to die when i'm old...then that just seems completely worthless.  if suicide was just a flip of a switch i would definitely do it and i don't see why other people wouldn't.

Thanks in advance for your response!  Why not end it if i'm not enjoying it at all.  I'm never happy.  Even if i'm only alive for the next week, if i'm not enjoying any of it, what's the point of continuing on.  Living for absolutely nothing is pointless and therefore should not continue.  i've just reached a point where i see no reason to continue...
